sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Wells State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: 2027 on the booking site (same on 2027-05-18, 06-15 and 09-21): modern 20/30-amp sites $30 (62 sites), 50-amp sites $35 (88); 3 rustic sites by the rustic cabins $25 (no electric, equipment to 25 ft). The DNR's 2026 table: modern $28 / $33, semi-modern $23 / $28 while the toilet/shower building is closed, rustic $20; the booking site charged $28 / $33 / $23 on 2026-10-27. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule ($30 / $35 modern and $25 rustic on 2027-05-18 / 2027-06-15 / 2027-09-21; $28 / $33 / $23 on 2026-10-27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Wells Campground: $33 / $28 modern, $28 / $23 semi-modern, $20 rustic; shower building May 15 to Oct. 31) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/jwwells ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/jwwells ('There is 30- or 50-amp electrical service available on each site') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (88 sites 20/30/50 A, 62 sites 20/30 A, all 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'; 3 rustic sites 'Electrical Service=Not Available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 150 modern sites in north and south loops, most flat and within view of Lake Michigan (ash trees were cleared over the 2025-26 winter, so sites are sunnier); equipment to 45 ft. Plus 3 rustic sites by the rustic cabins (to 25 ft).

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/jwwells ('Number of sites: 150'; 'Most sites are considered flat and within view of Lake Michigan'; 'We were busy this past winter clearing ash trees') + midnrreservations.com resources (150 modern campsites to 'Trailer or RV up to 45''; 3 sites on the 'Rustic Cabins and Sites' map to 25 ft), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/jwwells (Wells Modern Campground amenities 'Modern campground', 'Sanitation station', 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet'; 'The park's sanitation station is in the modern campground. There is potable water available and two lanes') + the DNR rates page ('Modern campgrounds include flush toilets, showers, a sanitation station'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/jwwells ('Wells Modern Campground: For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'), read 2026-10-22

summary: DNR park page + booking site: 150 modern sites (30 or 50 A at every site, 50 A at 88, electric only, equipment to 45 ft, shower building, vault toilets, sanitation station with potable water) plus 3 rustic sites to 25 ft; reservable online or by phone. Fees 20-33 (2026 DNR table) -> 25-35 (2027 booking site, rustic $25 the low; 2026 in the note), Recreation Passport in fees.note. Season May 1 - Oct 31 already manual. Pull-through not stated. --AWH note kept unchanged.
flags: Missing operator website and phone: the entry links only the bare reservation home page (https://midnrreservations.com/) and has no phone. The park's DNR page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/jwwells; park phone 906-863-9747 (reservations 800-447-2757).
